scope: Corollary 7.2 (Noise with a free first displacement) of the manuscript “Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps” (preprints/Metric-measure-limits-of-subcritical-FK-and-spanning-tree-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 48-49. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a > 0 and choose HN independently and uniformly from [a √ N, 2a √ N] ∩ Z. Concatenate HN ladder blocks. Writing TN , YN for their duration and second displacement, one has P[(TN , HN , YN ) = (k, m, ℓ)] = 2 aN2 gm/ √ N (k/N, ℓ/ √ N) + o(1)  (7.4) 48 uniformly on compact interior parameter sets of k + m + ℓ ≡ 0 (mod 2). The conditional contour kernel has the continuity and support properties in Lemma 7.1. Conditional on a fixed duration k ∼ tN, the free pair (HN , YN ) has a positive continuous lattice density of order N−1 on m+ℓ ≡ k (mod 2).
